title: Air-quality batch audit with explicit failure rules
instructions: Build an original air-quality batch report. Input lines use zone^sample^ppm: zone is 1–6 uppercase ASCII letters, sample is a canonical integer from 1 through 1000 and ppm is a canonical integer from 0 through 5000. Reject blank lines, whitespace changes and duplicate (zone, sample) pairs.

For each zone calculate sample count, peak ppm and alerts strictly above a supplied threshold (0–5000). Sort zones by natural String order. Output ZONE count=n peak=n alerts=n with a literal newline per zone.

Separate Sample, SampleFormatException, sample loading, statistics/report generation and CLI. Malformed data must report the 1-based physical line. parse(Reader) borrows its reader; generate(input, output, threshold) owns its file resources.

The CLI requires input path, output path and threshold. Return 0 for success, 1 for I/O/data errors and 2 for invalid arguments/threshold. Do not create or truncate output until parsing and validation succeed.

Design a component-level test plan including malformed input, duplicate sample IDs, exact-threshold behavior, resource ownership and pre-existing output preservation. There is no automatic grading of your design or code.
DelftStudy authored practice. The time class is a suggested practice budget, not an official assessment duration.
Write and review your own attempt before revealing the reference. Code on this page is ephemeral and is not compiled, run or automatically graded. Multiple correct implementations are valid.

requirements.text: Keep immutable validated sample data, parsing, report logic and CLI separate so processing can be tested without files or console input.
Validate all fields, reject duplicate zone/sample pairs and use a checked exception with the exact line number for malformed data.
Compute count, peak and strict-above-threshold alerts and format sorted output exactly; reject invalid thresholds.
Preserve borrowed-reader ownership, close owned resources, propagate I/O errors and keep existing output unchanged when parse validation fails.
Build meaningful positive/boundary/negative component tests; prioritize parsing plus one report example before connecting the full CLI.
